property.name: tickTime
property.description: The length of a single tick in milliseconds, which is the basic time unit used by ZooKeeper

property.name: initLimit
property.description: Ticks to allow for sync at Init.

property.name: syncLimit
property.description: Ticks to allow for sync at Runtime.

property.name: clientPort
property.description: Port for running ZK Server.

property.name: dataDir
property.description: Data directory for ZooKeeper.

property.name: autopurge.snapRetainCount
property.description: ZooKeeper purge feature retains the autopurge. snapRetainCount most recent snapshots and the corresponding transaction logs in the dataDir and dataLogDir respectively and deletes the rest.

property.name: autopurge.purgeInterval
property.description: The time interval in hours for which the purge task has to be triggered. Set to a positive integer (1 and above) to enable the auto purging.

property.name: maxClientCnxns
property.description: Limits the number of concurrent connections (at the socket level) that a single client, identified by IP address, may make to a single member of the ZooKeeper ensemble. Set to 0 to remove the limit (not recommended).

property.name: minSessionTimeout
property.description: Minimum session timeout in milliseconds that the server will allow the client to negotiate.

property.name: maxSessionTimeout
property.description: Maximum session timeout in milliseconds that the server will allow the client to negotiate.

property.name: snapCount
property.description: ZooKeeper logs transactions to a transaction log. After snapCount transactions are written to a log file, a snapshot is started and a new transaction log file is created.

property.name: globalOutstandingLimit
property.description: Maximum number of outstanding requests before clients are throttled.

property.name: quorumListenOnAllIPs
property.description: When true, the ZooKeeper server will listen for connections from its peers on all available IP addresses.

property.name: skipACL
property.description: When true, ZooKeeper skips ACL checks. Keep false on any shared or multi-tenant cluster.

property.name: 4lw.commands.whitelist
property.description: Comma-separated Four Letter Words commands to enable. Include ruok (liveness), srvr (zkServer.sh), mntr (metrics), and conf (runtime config) so operators and AI detectors can inspect the quorum.

property.name: admin.enableServer
property.description: Set to "false" to disable the AdminServer. By default the AdminServer is enabled.

property.name: admin.serverPort
property.description: The port the embedded Jetty server listens on. Defaults to 8080.

property.name: metricsProvider.className
property.description: ZooKeeper prometheus metrics provider.

property.name: metricsProvider.httpPort
property.description: ZooKeeper prometheus metrics provider http port.

property.name: content
property.description: The port the embedded Jetty server listens on. Defaults to 8080.
property.value:
<#compress> <#list model as key,value> <#if value??> <#if value?string == 'true'> ${key}=true <#elseif value?string == 'false'> ${key}=false <#else> ${key}=${value} </#if> </#if> </#list> </#compress>
<#noparse> <#if zk_server_str?? > ${zk_server_str} </#if>
<#if security_enabled?? && security_enabled > authProvider.1=org.apache.zookeeper.server.auth.SASLAuthenticationProvider jaasLoginRenew=3600000 kerberos.removeHostFromPrincipal=true kerberos.removeRealmFromPrincipal=true </#if> </#noparse>
